scope.statement: For the complete grid P={i*u+j*v: 0<=i<=M, 0<=j<=N}, M,N>=1, and unit vectors with pi/3<theta<pi/2, audit whether rotating theta continuously to pi/2 preserves every full-source lower pair bound and strictly lowers the exact maximum pair distance, while rotation toward pi/3 has the opposite diameter sign.
scope.domain: All M,N>=1 complete unit-rhombic grids with pi/3<theta<pi/2, including every integer label difference and every same-cardinality label on both angle paths; exact six-label fixture M=2,N=1, cos(theta)=7/25.
scope.limitations: Finite complete-grid geometry only. No transfer to incomplete or multi-grain sources, arbitrary jammed configurations, global minimizers, sufficiently large cardinalities, or Level I. The canonical theorem lifecycle remains unchanged.

result: Independent algebraic reconstruction proves the non-axis lower bound, exact maximum-pair formula, full active/inactive upper-pair evolution, and opposite sign of phase contraction. Exact replay checks the 15 pairs of the rational fixture and 57,024 bounded label-difference cases.
remaining_questions: Find a source-derived deformation for an incomplete or multi-grain Target B survivor that preserves every lower pair and controls every actual active diameter pair.
